data.name: Mustansir
data.gender_notes: Mustansir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guides and leads, one who finds and discovers, one who is well-acquainted with the truth and the path to Allah. The name Mustansir carries the meaning “Guide, leader, finder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mustansir usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader, finder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual guide and leader, one who helps others find the truth and the path to Allah
data.etymology: Mustansir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, leader, finder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustansir total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مُستانصر
in_arabic.meaning: يَستَنسَحُ بِالنَصرةِ وَالصِبرِ وَالصَبرُ عَلى النَصرةِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم "مُستانصر" مشتق من الجذر "س-ن-ص"، وَهو مُرَكَّب مِن كَلِمَةي "مُستَنصَر" و "النَصرة". يُعد مِن أَنْوَاع أَسْماءِ اللَهِ الَّتي تَحمل قِيَمَ فِعْلِيَّة، وَيُستَمعَ مِنَ الَّذينَ يُجِدونَ النَصرةَ وَالصِبرَ. في الْقُرءانِ كَثير مِنَ الآيَاتِ الَّتي تَتَمَثَّل فِيهِ فِي قِيَمَ النَصرةِ وَالصِبرِ، وَهَذا اسْمٌ مُشِيعٌ لِلأَولياءِ الَّذينَ يُحِبُّونَ اللَهَ وَيَرجَونَ مِنهُ، وَيُحِبُّونَ النَصرةَ وَالصِبرَ لِلعَدوِّ الَّذي يَقَطِّعُ بَيَنَهُمُ وَبَينَ اللَهِ

in_urdu.name: مُستانصر
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو اللہ کی مدد میں رہتا ہے اور صبر کرتا ہے اور صبر اللہ کی مدد پر ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام میں "س-ن-ص" کے جذر سے نکلا ہے اور "مُستَنصَر" اور "النصر" کے ناموں سے مل کر بنا ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کی حمد و ثنا کے عمل کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کا ذکر قرآن میں بھی ملتا ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کے بندوں کے لیے مشہور ہے جو اللہ سے محبت کرتے ہیں اور اس کے عذاب سے ڈرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुस्तांसिर
in_hindi.meaning: वह जो अल्लाह की मदद में रहता है और धैर्य करता है और धैर्य अल्लाह की मदद पर होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम "मुस्तांसिर" का अर्थ "स-न-ص" के जड़ से निकला हुआ है और "मुस्तांसिर" और "नस्रा" नामों से मिलकर बना हुआ है। यह नाम अल्लाह की वंदना और प्रशंसा का काम करता है। इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरान में भी मिलता है। यह नाम अल्लाह के बन्दों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है जो अल्लाह से प्यार करते हैं और उसके दंड से डरते हैं।

in_pashto.name: مُستانصر
in_pashto.meaning: دوی چې په نصره او صبر کې وي او نصره او صبر له ښه وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم "س-ن-ص" جذر څخه اخستل شوی دی چې "مُستانصر" او "النصره" له له مخې جوړ شوی دی. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ د حمد او ثناء د عمل څرګندويي ده. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ په قرآن کې هم په شتون کې دي. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ د بندو لپاره مشهور دی چې الله تعالیٰ ته محبت کوي او د الله تعالیٰ د عذاب څخه ډار کوي.

in_english.name: Mustansir
in_english.meaning: The one who relies on Allah's support and endures with patience and trust in Allah's help
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mustansir is derived from the Arabic root "s-n-ç", meaning "support" and "strength". The name is a combination of the words "Mustansir" and "Nasir", both of which convey the meaning of relying on Allah's help and support. In the Quran, there are numerous verses that emphasize the importance of relying on Allah's support and strength in times of hardship and difficulty. This name is commonly used to refer to individuals who have demonstrated great patience and endurance in the face of adversity, and who have placed their trust in Allah's help and support.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mustansir is of Arabic origin and is often used in several Islamic cultures. In these cultures, the name holds a high esteem due to its association with leaders and guides. The name is reminiscent of the caliph Mustansir Billah, who ruled the Abbasid Caliphate in the 11th century. He was renowned for his justice, wisdom, and strong leadership, and under his rule, the Islamic Golden Age flourished. Thus, the name Mustansir came to symbolize a noble, righteous, and just leader.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Mustansir holds a profound meaning. It is a reminder of the guiding presence of Allah in our lives and the importance of seeking knowledge and the truth. The name encourages the pursuit of wisdom and knowledge as a means of spiritual growth and enlightenment. As a person named Mustansir, one is called to be a seeker of truth and a guide for others, leading them towards a more righteous and virtuous path in life. Ultimately, the name Mustansir signifies the journey towards Allah, and the role of the seeker as a leader and guide in this journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, leader, finder" symbolizes One who guides and leads, one who finds and discovers, one who is well-acquainted with the truth and the path to Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mustansir serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, leader, finder.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mustansir was a title given to the Abbasid caliph Al-Mustansir Billah in the 11th century. The name Mustansir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The title was used during the Fatimid Caliphate and the Abbasid Caliphate.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and North Africa
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mustansir remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
